title: AiHarness terminal theme
description: Complete terminal palette fields accepted by Core ThemeManager. Partial colors inherit the selected built-in appearance. Runtime additionally enforces 256 KiB stable UTF-8 regular-file admission, UTF-16 name/value ceilings, exact variable references and acyclic resolution. Unknown root metadata is retained as inert compatibility data; unknown color/export tokens are refused.

appearance.description: Preferred appearance. Absent/null uses legacy mode; a nonnull appearance takes precedence over mode.

mode.description: Legacy appearance, required as dark/light when appearance is absent/null. Otherwise ignored by the runtime.

vars.description: Case-sensitive exact variable names. References resolve before literal colors; cycles and unresolved nonliteral values are runtime errors.

colors.description: All rich renderer, Markdown, diff, syntax, thinking, search, scrollbar and legacy user/assistant tokens. Omitted tokens inherit built-in colors.

export.description: Literal colors only, not variable references. Eight-digit hex alpha is accepted but discarded, as in runtime terminal colors.

anyOf.description: Exact case-sensitive variable reference. Runtime additionally requires the variable to exist and resolve without cycles; a named literal color remains valid without a variable.

oneOf.description: Trimmed #RGB/#RRGGBB/#RRGGBBAA or case-insensitive black, white, red, green, blue, yellow, cyan, magenta, gray, grey, transparent. Variable names are not resolved here.
